    • Matthew
      5.0 out of 5 stars Great Value, Fun Rip, and a Cool Collectible
      Reviewed in the United States on May 7, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      These Poké Ball tins are exactly why Pokémon products are still so much fun to open. The presentation alone is awesome—the tin itself is sturdy, well-designed, and makes a great display piece or storage for cards after you’re done ripping packs.

      Inside, you get a solid mix of booster packs, and while pulls are always luck-based, it definitely feels like a fair shot compared to a lot of other sealed products. Even when the hits aren’t huge, the variety of packs keeps it interesting and worth it.

      What I like most is the versatility—great for collectors, kids, or even just something fun to crack open on a random night. Also makes a perfect gift since it looks premium without being overpriced.

      Only thing to keep in mind is that pack selection can vary, so don’t expect specific sets every time—but that’s part of the fun.

      Overall, a really enjoyable product that delivers on both the experience and value. I’d definitely pick up more.
